provisional_single_gpu_capacity.unit_definition: One recipient unit = one new fitted adapter plus its OFF/ON development evaluations. One paired learner-seed unit = whole_raw and act_only recipients at the same seed, run serially on ONE GPU. These are not successful discoveries, lifelong learners, or completed developmental lives.

overhead_scope: V3 train_seconds excludes model/tokenizer cold load; V3 wall_seconds is run_training on an already-loaded base, includes local setup/save, not whole fit subprocess.
memory_dose train_meta.wall_seconds starts after tokenization/base/adapter/optimizer setup and before adapter save: native loop time despite the wall_seconds name.

Production/demonstration controller and arm timers include their internal validation and model load/close, not just decoding. Controller-minus-arm residual is unpartitioned orchestration/validation, not an isolated hash benchmark.
Exact-row call timers cover native generate/score operations; runner-minus-call residual includes startup/loading/hash/check/cleanup/analysis and cannot isolate cold-start cost.
Preparation, external capture/audit, original source generation, inherited fits and failed attempts have separate scopes. None may be silently counted as free or assembled into total campaign cost.

next_pilot.status: descriptive proposal only; no implementation, launch, reservation, gate change, or new tests
next_pilot.critical_path_owner: Main; cumulative remains live at the requested evidence cut and Main will add terminal results
serial_dependency_graph: Main freezes prospective pilot scope, exact eligible own-output bytes, selection denominator, control/readouts and finite budget; public validity does not auto-authorize training.

Acquire or reuse source-bound own output and original public feedback; keep all failures and teacher/example provenance; exclude teacher text from update targets and freeze any outcome-dependent selection rule explicitly.
CPU preparation: exact hashes/overlap/visibility checks, tokenization and shifted target masks, immutable corpus/recipe manifest; do not silently pad/rewrite/truncate data.
Main verifies reservation readiness within existing rules; reserve one device continuously and account startup and hash validation.
Known SEQ-085 order: fresh-base own-output LoRA fit -> immutable save/DONE/hash validation -> trainer cleanup.
Fresh-process teacher-free OFF evaluation -> owned cleanup -> fresh-process saved-adapter reload/hash check -> identical ON evaluation -> cleanup.
Bind raw generations/native scores/actual token and time receipts; separate acquisition, transfer, retention and selection limits; preserve artifacts -> Main release verification.
Only after terminal evidence: Main chooses whether another seed/cycle is scientifically warranted; later-cycle retention or cumulative writes have a new dependency and are not priced from one fit.
next_pilot.cost_equation: T_pilot = T_source_output + T_external_preparation + T_continuous_reservation; T_continuous_reservation = load/validate + fit + save/check + cleanup + fresh OFF load/eval/cleanup + fresh ON load/eval/cleanup + terminal validation/release.
next_pilot.known_analogue: SEQ-085 recipient controller covers fit plus OFF/ON and internal custody; does not cover a new source production/selection phase, external preparation/audit, or full reservation endpoints.

resource_schedule.scope: Schedule only; no assertion of presently available/onboarded capacity; no lease/extension/onboarding action.

dataset_and_selection_limitations: Only a selected set of terminal diagnostic receipts, one failed-attempt partial record, and current preparation/launch/progress reports are represented. No total campaign cost, billing, utilization, or throughput claim.

SEQ-085: one retrospectively selected solved child event, replayed 32 times, three recipient seeds per arm, 32 same-gym development questions; six repeated OFF evaluations are one deterministic baseline. No independent-experience replication; equal steps are not equal target/input token dose.
SEQ-087: 128 exact seen training prompts per root, fixed inherited adapters, root/optimizer-seed confounding; not held-out retention or generalization. Failed root0 attempt is kept separate.

SEQ-088/090: eight constructed board checks per arm; 7101/7102/7103 are sampler seeds, not learner seeds. Strict primary SEQ-090 grounding is 0/48. Post-hoc normalization is not a new terminal primary result.

SEQ-091: eight demonstrated sources and eight transfer cases per arm, one sampler seed; process grounding 2/8 source and 1/8 transfer versus 0/8 control, context-only. Demonstration echo and outcome-selected output eligibility limit subsequent learning claims; no output training approval or persistence claim follows.

Cumulative: synthetic researcher-planted OLD/NEW memory diagnostic, fresh-base replay/reconstruction, NOT warm-start updating OLD weights, catastrophic-forgetting evidence, or an own-output developmental life. OLD nonselectivity is not repaired by throughput.

Local source/model hashes establish local byte identity, not official base-origin authentication or exhaustive prior/hidden-storage contamination clearance. No clean-lineage, P1/G3/G5/H1/H2 or campaign-completion claim.
No latency p50/p95, peak VRAM, utilization, energy, or isolated cold-load/hash/evaluation timings are estimated from inventories, output characters, caps, or small heterogeneous samples.
